preservedPreparationStops.cause: Historical remux container duration differs from the frame-aligned baseline, despite identical encoded audio packet bytes.
preservedPreparationStops.correction: Require exact effective stream duration for completed and baseline media; for historical observation media verify packet bytes and decoder skip/padding, and record container duration separately.

preservedPreparationStops.cause: Eight saved ASR endpoints preserve long decimal residues and cannot be represented as integer 16kHz samples without rounding.
preservedPreparationStops.correction: Transport saved seconds as exact rational sample positions; preserve large numerators/denominators as decimal strings, exclude decoder tail and keep insertions unobserved.

limitations: Saved ASR, acoustic candidates and peaks are historical observations, not new completed-media observations.
Exact transport preserves timestamps and does not prove the physical accuracy of ASR timing.
Source-clock correspondence and packet identity do not establish audiovisual meaning or completed-video quality.
No external API, new dependency, media generation, source-media change, previous-answer import, or old automatic-choice execution.
